title: Maximum fan-in bound after unfolding
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $g$ be a well-formed gate, and let $t$ assign a Boolean circuit on $n$ variables to each gate argument and polarity. If $g$ has at most $k$ arguments and every circuit $t(a,q)$ assigned to an argument of $g$ has maximum fan-in at most $k$, then the circuit obtained by unfolding $g$ at any polarity has maximum fan-in at most $k$.
hypotheses_covered: $g$ is well formed: its argument list has no repetitions and, if it is a NOT gate, has length one
The gate has at most $k$ arguments
Every circuit assigned to an argument of $g$ at either polarity has maximum fan-in at most $k
